# My Little Pet

Free virtual-pet games by Teja Priyan. Free and Plus Windows downloads and an installable mobile pet room. No checkout, subscription or activation. Game items use earned coins only. Optional support: https://buymeacoffee.com/tejapriyan

- [Downloads](https://www.mylittlepet.in/#download)
- [Guide](https://www.mylittlepet.in/guide.html)
- [Privacy](https://www.mylittlepet.in/privacy.html)
- [Support](https://www.mylittlepet.in/contact.html)
